name: PMG
author: SafeDep
description: Supply-chain protection in the bar: a package icon that shows PMG's status and alerts when it blocks a malicious install.

barWidget.description: One package icon and a panel: protection health, the active layers, today's tally, and a live feed of what PMG allowed, held, and blocked.

schema.label: Status refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to poll `pmg setup info --json` for protection health and layers.

schema.label: Activity feed rows
schema.description: How many recent events to show in the panel's activity feed.

schema.label: Fullscreen alert on a block
schema.description: Show a fullscreen alert the moment PMG blocks a malicious package.

schema.label: Desktop notification on a block
schema.description: Send an omarchy notification when PMG blocks a malicious package.
